result.topic_en: Euler compares the fundamental tones of the four cases of vibrating elastic rods, gives their pitch names (gis, d, C, fis), and notes in a scholium that the case with both ends simply fixed yields exact, harmonious tones proportional to 1, 4, 9, 16, 25.

Corollarium 2.

§. 37. Quodſi ſonos fundamentales omnium horum quatuor caſuum, quos hactenus tractauimus, inter ſe comparemus, iam vidimus, ſi ſonus primi caſus exprimatur per $\overline{gis}$, pro ſecundo caſu eum fore $\overline{d}$, ac pro tertio C, qui ſoni his numeris exprimuntur: $\frac{9}{4}$, $\frac{25}{16}$, $\frac{9}{25}$. Hinc cum praeſenti caſu quarto ſonus fundamentalis exprimatur vnitate, ſonus erit fis; ſeriem igitur hoc modo referamus:

I. $\frac{9}{4}$. II. $\frac{25}{16}$. III. $\frac{9}{25}$. IV. $1$.
$\overline{gis}$ $\overline{d}$ C fis

Scholion.

§. 38. Hic igitur caſus, quo vterque virgae terminus ſimpliciter eſt fixus, prae reliquis hac inſigni gaudet praerogatiua, quod omnes valores anguli $\omega$ accurate ſine vllo errore definire licuit, propterea quod formulae exponentiales, quae hanc determinationem turbabant et non parum irregularem reddebant, penitus ex calculo euanuerunt; vnde ſoni hoc caſu editi multo magis ad harmoniam ſunt accommodati, et quidem adhuc magis quam in chordis ſimplicibus vſu venit. Cum enim ſoni ab eadem chorda editi ſecundum numeros 1, 2, 3, 4 etc. progrediantur, fere ſemper plures horum ſonorum ſimul audiuntur, inter quos etiam non parum diſſoni occurrere poſſunt. Verum quia a noſtra virga alii ſoni edi non poſſunt, niſi qui numeris 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 exprimuntur, praeter fundamentalem potiſſimum exaudietur eius duplex octaua, harmoniam nihil turbans, poſtea vero ſequetur ſonus numero 9 reſpondens, qui, cum funda-

items.english: This case, in which both ends of the rod are simply fixed, enjoys above the others this remarkable privilege, that all values of the angle ω could be determined exactly without any error.

items.quote: Verum quia a noſtra virga alii ſoni edi non poſſunt, niſi qui numeris 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 exprimuntur
items.english: But since no other tones can be produced by our rod except those expressed by the numbers 1, 4, 9, 16, 25.
